description: The line plot illustrates the similarity of different configurations of a multilingual language model (LLM) across various layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is linear, with values ranging from 0 to 22, indicating the number of layers in the LLM. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" and is linear, with values ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, representing the degree of similarity between the configurations. There are four lines in the plot, each representing a different configuration: "en&en" in red, "en&es" in blue, "en&el" in green, and "en&bn" in purple. The "en&en" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.35 at layer 6, and then declines to about 0.10 by layer 22. The "en&es" line begins at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.30 at layer 6, and then declines to about 0.05 by layer 22. The "en&el" line starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.20 at layer 6, and then declines to about 0.05 by layer 22. The "en&bn" line begins at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.15 at layer 6, and then declines to about 0.05 by layer 22. All lines show a general decline in similarity after layer 6, with a sharp increase in similarity at layer 22.
